proven_gaps.fact: Human retry changes nonce while the existing Host pending row remains durable; renderer discard does not delete or settle that Host row. Reply context is also omitted from retrySubmission.
proven_gaps.consequence: A new local intent can coexist with the original pending intent; original sync recovery remains eligible. Simply preserving nonce without restoring reply will conflict with Host immutable-intent checks.

proven_gaps.fact: Initial Human dispatch replaces staging paths with committed Host paths. The staging bridge only accepts paths inside its staging directory. Human optimistic attachments are not updated at the same point as the Agent branch.
proven_gaps.consequence: A reopened Host pending attachment cannot be sent through an unconditional staging commit. Retry must recover committed paths from the existing Host intent.

proven_gaps.fact: Current model maps dispatching to pending but ignores lastDispatchError. Host stores failed upload/send as pending with lastDispatchError.
proven_gaps.consequence: The live failed surface is not restored from durable error metadata after reopen.

proven_gaps.fact: submit always records.set(nonce,newRecord). A second same-nonce submit can replace a running record and queue behind its activeByAgent entry. Old finish returns immediately if its record is no longer current, leaving the active lane occupied.
proven_gaps.consequence: Naive same-nonce UI retry can leave the new queued retry and the old completion unresolved. Reserve/deduplicate the Human retry before any asynchronous preparation; do not await transcript reads before entering or reserving the existing queue.

proven_gaps.fact: The queue is created once, disposed on component lifetime, and not reset in the account-change callback. Scope-dependent queue callbacks use the current acknowledgement scope. resend nonce cleanup is unconditional.
proven_gaps.consequence: A consumer repair needs a reusable account-generation reset and stale-callback suppression; permanent dispose would also prevent subsequent valid sends. Old finally cleanup must not delete a new account's same-nonce retry marker.

proven_gaps.fact: Ordinary sendHumanMessage supplies no forwardContext; an existing nonce requires identical forwardContext. Forward v1 pending belongs to the source journal and is excluded from generic sync send replay.
proven_gaps.consequence: Do not project forward pending into an ordinary Retry action or reconstruct it as an ordinary send. Retain source journal/dialog/sync recovery ownership.

Return an already-settled local row without creating another intent. For pending recovery, send the same nonce and senderId=verified Host userId; bypass staging commit and retain Host immutable-intent checks.

proposed_existing_owner_boundary_not_imp.queue: Use the existing queue/acknowledgement owner. Reserve or reuse an active same-nonce Human retry synchronously; put identity/transcript preparation inside its send operation. Preserve Agent fresh-nonce behavior and approval lifecycle.
